money_movements_source.name: money_movements_source
money_movements_source.value: num_nonnulls("money_movements"."account_opening_id","money_movements"."sale_payment_id","money_movements"."expense_payment_id","money_movements"."owner_transaction_id")=1 and (("money_movements"."account_opening_id" is not null and "money_movements"."day_id" is null) or ("money_movements"."account_opening_id" is null and "money_movements"."day_id" is not null))

money_movements_delta.name: money_movements_delta
money_movements_delta.value: ("money_movements"."expense_payment_id" is not null and "money_movements"."delta" between -9000000000000 and -1) or ("money_movements"."owner_transaction_id" is not null and "money_movements"."delta" between -9000000000000 and 9000000000000 and "money_movements"."delta"<>0) or ("money_movements"."expense_payment_id" is null and "money_movements"."owner_transaction_id" is null and "money_movements"."delta" between 1 and 9000000000000)

reconciliation_lines_values.name: reconciliation_lines_values
reconciliation_lines_values.value: "reconciliation_lines"."channel" in ('CASH','TRANSFER') and "reconciliation_lines"."target" between -9000000000000 and 9000000000000 and "reconciliation_lines"."delta" = "reconciliation_lines"."target"::numeric - "reconciliation_lines"."recorded" and "reconciliation_lines"."delta" between 0 and 9000000000000 and (("reconciliation_lines"."delta" = 0 and "reconciliation_lines"."resulting_sale_id" is null) or ("reconciliation_lines"."delta" > 0 and "reconciliation_lines"."resulting_sale_id" is not null))

sale_items_values.name: sale_items_values
sale_items_values.value: "sale_items"."position" between 0 and 99 and "sale_items"."quantity" between 1 and 999 and "sale_items"."product_version" > 0 and length(trim("sale_items"."name_snapshot")) between 1 and 120 and "sale_items"."unit_price" > 0 and "sale_items"."line_total" = "sale_items"."unit_price"::numeric * "sale_items"."quantity" and "sale_items"."line_total" <= 9000000000000

sale_payments_channel.name: sale_payments_channel
sale_payments_channel.value: ("sale_payments"."channel" = 'CASH' and "sale_payments"."tendered" is not null and "sale_payments"."change" is not null and "sale_payments"."tendered" between "sale_payments"."amount" and 9000000000000 and "sale_payments"."change" = "sale_payments"."tendered" - "sale_payments"."amount") or ("sale_payments"."channel" = 'TRANSFER' and "sale_payments"."tendered" is null and "sale_payments"."change" is null)

sales_amounts.name: sales_amounts
sales_amounts.value: "sales"."gross" > 0 and "sales"."gross" <= 9000000000000 and "sales"."discount" between 0 and "sales"."gross" and "sales"."net" = "sales"."gross" - "sales"."discount" and "sales"."net" > 0

sales_kind_details.name: sales_kind_details
sales_kind_details.value: ("sales"."kind" = 'POS' and "sales"."reason" is null) or ("sales"."kind" in ('SUPPLEMENTAL','RECONCILIATION') and "sales"."reason" is not null and length(trim("sales"."reason")) between 1 and 1000 and "sales"."discount" = 0)
